question: Is the measure and quote really free?
answer: Yes. One of our estimators visits, measures the site, talks through options and emails a fixed written quote within 48 hours. There's no obligation and no call-out fee anywhere in Perth metro or the South West.

question: How do I book a measure?
answer: Use the chat assistant (bottom-right), the 'Book a free measure' form, or call either office. You'll pick a morning or afternoon window and get an SMS reminder the day before.

question: How long from quote to installed fence?
answer: Most residential jobs are installed 2–3 weeks after you accept the quote. Custom aluminium slat, blade and frameless glass need extra fabrication time — usually another 1–2 weeks.

question: Do I have to pay for the whole dividing fence?
answer: Under the WA Dividing Fences Act, neighbours generally share the cost of a 'sufficient' dividing fence 50/50. We can prepare the cost-sharing paperwork and send the quote to your neighbour for you.

question: Will my pool fence pass inspection?
answer: Every pool fence we install is built to AS 1926.1-2012 and checked against the WA inspection checklist before we leave — height, gaps, non-climbable zones and gate latching. We'll fix anything flagged at inspection free of charge.

question: What colours are available?
answer: Colorbond fencing comes in 22 colours, with Monument, Woodland Grey, Basalt and Surfmist the most popular in Perth right now. Aluminium products can be powder coated in any Dulux Duralloy colour.

question: Can I buy materials and install myself?
answer: Absolutely. We sell supply-only kits for Colorbond, PVC, pool and slat fencing with pick-up from Osborne Park or Bunbury, or delivery from $85. Our team will help you work out quantities.

question: Do you do commercial and mine-site work?
answer: Yes — our commercial team prices from drawings and tender documents, provides SWMS and certificates of currency, and runs FIFO crews for regional sites. Email projects@saltbushfencing.com.au with your drawings.

question: Do your prices include GST?
answer: Every price on this website includes GST. 'Installed' prices include materials and labour; 'supply only' prices are materials only. Your written quote will list exactly what's included.

question: What warranty do I get?
answer: All installations come with a 10-year Saltbush workmanship warranty, on top of manufacturer warranties (e.g. BlueScope for Colorbond steel, 2 years on gate motors).

question: How does payment work?
answer: A 30% deposit secures your install date, and the balance is due on completion. We accept bank transfer and card, and offer interest-free plans on jobs over $2,000.

question: What do you do with my details?
answer: We only use your details to arrange your measure, quote and install. We never sell or share your information. Chat transcripts are kept for 90 days to help us follow up on enquiries.
